## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior has a test
- [ ] If this adds/changes stack support: added a real `examples/broken-<stack>` /
      `examples/fixed-<stack>` fixture and e2e acceptance test (not just unit-tested rules)
- [ ] If this changes the scenario schema: updated `docs/scenario.schema.json`
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md`
